clips.title: The story
paras: Menethil Keep commands the skyline above Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Four watchtowers guard the Alliance port, and Captain Stoutfist leads its militia from within the stone walls.

Menethil Keep rises over Menethil Harbor’s wooden docks and the Wetlands marshes. Four stone watchtowers overlook the town and bay, watching for seaward raiders, renegades, and swamp beasts pushing into the area. Within the fortress, Captain Stoutfist directs the town militia and organizes patrols to defend the port and protect Alliance interests across the region.
